# SecretField other than str and bytes

### Description

Hi, I'm interested in marking some fields as PII using SecretFields. This means handling other types of data such as dates and enums. (see [resource](https://www.osec.doc.gov/opog/privacy/pii_bii.html))
I've seen the implementation for `_SecretField` to try to implement my own but it's asserting that if it's not a string, then it must be bytes (see [link](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/blob//pydantic/types.py#L1481))
Is there any way to handle dates and enums as a secret field?

### Affected Components

- [X] [Data serialization](https://docs.pydantic.dev/concepts/serialization/) - `.model_dump()` and `.model_dump_json()`
